proposals.evidence: Turner gives Kumaoni sīṇo/seṇo repose/sleep and Prakrit sēi/sēaï under śete. The Dotyali sī-/śe-/śi- sleep series matches that eastern Pahari e/i-vowel stem with the survey -yo ending. This is a regional comparative assignment; the source s versus ś is preserved, and it is not grouped with t-bearing supta past forms.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Bengali/Oriya ubhā upright and explicitly identifies denominative stand verbs, including Nepali ubhinu and Hindi ūbhnā, under ūrdhva. These survey ub(h)- stand forms are grouped as derivatives of the upright adjective, with ordinary past or infinitive endings. The r-expanded ubhār- formation has its own etymon and is not included.
